bug_info.bug_desc: In the ReseedPrep state, the flag0_i=1 branch is intended to skip entropy waiting and proceed to the reseed request state. The old code incorrectly sets state_d to InstantReq, so a reseed command with flag0_i=1 causes the FSM to enter the instantiate request state and assert instant_req_o instead of reseed_req_o. This violates the command-decode and command-request requirements: a reseed command must issue a reseed request, not an instantiate request.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the ReseedPrep state, when flag0_i is set, change the next-state assignment from InstantReq to ReseedReq so that the FSM proceeds to the correct request state and asserts reseed_req_o.
